scripts.infra:up: bws run -- docker compose up -d social-care-db
scripts.infra:auth:init: bws run -- /bin/zsh -lc 'docker compose up -d logto-db && sleep 5 && DB_URL=postgresql://$LOGTO_DB_USER:$LOGTO_DB_PASSWORD@localhost:5434/$LOGTO_DB_NAME bunx @logto/cli db seed --no-interact'
scripts.infra:auth:up: bws run -- docker compose up -d logto-db logto
scripts.infra:reset-db: bws run -- docker compose down -v && bws run -- docker compose up -d social-care-db
